note: Minimum goodput per QUIC Interop Runner measurement cell (runner 740c05a; key = server->client:measurement, the runner's own naming as in required.json; value in kbps, the unit the runner reports). Recorded numbers: docs/spec/rfc-compliance.md, Interop matrix K3 «Measurements» (JVM image, the runner's 10 Mbit/s link, each the mean of the runner's 5 repetitions). Rule: min_kbps = recorded mean x (1 - tolerance), rounded down to 100 kbps; tolerance 0.25 for goodput (5 repetitions, recorded spread at most 1 %), 0.40 for crosstraffic (the share left by a competing TCP CUBIC flow; recorded spread up to 13 % and GitHub-hosted runners add CPU noise). Only cells with a recorded green measurement are listed: ngtcp2 and quinn, both roles, JVM image. tools/interop/check-perf.sh checks a run against this file; check-perf.sh --update proposes new values from a run.
